verdict.summary_en: Korean-language delivery note (거래명세서) DN-261112-486 dated 2026.11.12 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center, Hamburg, against PO 4500318733. One line: CMP-GAM-001 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6, 68 000 PCS in 34 boxes, total weight 544 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. The remarks field is empty. A red company stamp and a handwritten receiver signature ("Yilmaz D.") are present. There are no corrections or quality notes.
observations: Red round stamp "HWASEONG MEMORY CO LTD" with a star overlaps the unit (PCS) and box count (34) cells of the table. Both are still readable, though the unit looks like "RCS" where the stamp covers it.
The stamp contains no date or number.
Handwritten blue signature "Yilmaz D." on the receiver line (인수자). It has no date and is not a correction.
The document has no receiving date stamp. The only date is the printed document date 2026.11.12.
Quantity 68 000 uses a space as thousands separator. 34 boxes, 544 kg and 68 000 PCS do not contradict each other.
The PO number is printed next to the label 발주번호.
A barcode is printed at the top right.
